verdict.rationale: First-party docs directly state you can build and deploy serverless functions and full-stack apps on Cloudflare's global network with no servers to manage. They also document framework support (React, Next, Astro, and others) and Wrangler deploy and rollback commands. Hands-on community reports corroborate it, including an API running in production within an hour and a startup built almost entirely on Workers. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of full-stack framework deployments specifically (community evidence covers APIs and Workers generally), plus reported runtime constraints such as no full Node runtime and CPU-time caps that limit some apps.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy serverless functions and full-stack apps with no servers to manage

citations.quote: Build and deploy serverless functions and full-stack apps on Cloudflare's global network. No servers to manage.
Build full-stack apps with your framework of choice, including React, Vue, Svelte, Next, Astro, React Router, and more
The core Wrangler commands for creating, developing, and deploying Workers are on the Workers commands page.
Cloudflare Workers let you deploy serverless code instantly across the globe for exceptional performance, reliability, and scale.
They said the API was running in production within an hour: "Workers are so damn good and easy."
